title: 電漿晶圓切割
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入遮罩、深蝕刻及膜框熱邊界。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore masking, deep etch and frame thermal boundaries, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 分離設計
stages.description: 針對分離設計完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for singulation design, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 街道版圖｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對街道版圖，把「遮罩開口需避開金屬與功能層，街道並非只有矽。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For street layout, turn "Mask openings must accommodate metals and functional films; streets are not pure silicon." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「街道版圖」的模型：遮罩開口需避開金屬與功能層，街道並非只有矽。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「列街道逐層材料。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for street layout: Mask openings must accommodate metals and functional films; streets are not pure silicon. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: List the layer stack in each street. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 列街道逐層材料。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: List the layer stack in each street. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：矽可蝕刻就能直接穿透全部街道材料。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming Si etching removes every street material. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付街道版圖的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for street layout, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「電漿晶圓切割」的「街道版圖｜機制與設計」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出晶粒、基板、接點與量測端的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「接合線：失蹤的良率」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與批號、接合位置、熱歷史、接點讀值與顯微圖版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Street layout | mechanism and design” in “Plasma wafer dicing”. Draw the die, substrate, joint and measurement interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “The Bonding Line: Lost Yield” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for lot, joint location, thermal history, contact readings and micrograph version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 在「街道版圖」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For street layout — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 遮罩開口需避開金屬與功能層，街道並非只有矽。
矽可蝕刻就能直接穿透全部街道材料
垂直側壁即可保證表面平滑
optionsEn: Mask openings must accommodate metals and functional films; streets are not pure silicon.
Assuming Si etching removes every street material
Equating vertical walls with smooth walls
quiz.explanation: 遮罩開口需避開金屬與功能層，街道並非只有矽。 列街道逐層材料。 因此不能採用「矽可蝕刻就能直接穿透全部街道材料」。
quiz.explanationEn: Mask openings must accommodate metals and functional films; streets are not pure silicon. List the layer stack in each street. Therefore reject: Assuming Si etching removes every street material.

steps.title: 街道版圖｜證據與診斷
steps.objective: 針對街道版圖，把「遮罩開口需避開金屬與功能層，街道並非只有矽。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。

steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: List the layer stack in each street. Challenge the hypothesis "Assuming Si etching removes every street material" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 列街道逐層材料。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: List the layer stack in each street. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：矽可蝕刻就能直接穿透全部街道材料。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming Si etching removes every street material. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付街道版圖的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for street layout: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.observation: 用最慢區深度和最大遮罩損失估算。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Use slowest-site depth and greatest mask loss. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：平均選擇比可確保所有位置遮罩存活。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using mean selectivity to guarantee mask survival everywhere. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付遮罩預算的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for mask budget: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

knowledge.title: 遮罩預算：機制
knowledge.text: 遮罩選擇比須保留過蝕與非均勻性餘量。
knowledge.textEn: Mask selectivity needs margin for overetch and nonuniformity.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 用最慢區深度和最大遮罩損失估算。 必須排除的錯判：平均選擇比可確保所有位置遮罩存活。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Use slowest-site depth and greatest mask loss. Misinterpretation to reject: Using mean selectivity to guarantee mask survival everywhere. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「遮罩預算」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For mask budget — evidence and diagnosis — which decision or action is justified?
options: 平均選擇比可確保所有位置遮罩存活
平均深度達厚度就表示全部切開
用最慢區深度和最大遮罩損失估算。
optionsEn: Using mean selectivity to guarantee mask survival everywhere
Equating mean depth with complete singulation
Use slowest-site depth and greatest mask loss.
quiz.explanation: 遮罩選擇比須保留過蝕與非均勻性餘量。 用最慢區深度和最大遮罩損失估算。 因此不能採用「平均選擇比可確保所有位置遮罩存活」。
quiz.explanationEn: Mask selectivity needs margin for overetch and nonuniformity. Use slowest-site depth and greatest mask loss. Therefore reject: Using mean selectivity to guarantee mask survival everywhere.
